root: ^Softly, not looking at you. Sheila… she used to be afraid of the dark, you know? She lets out a quiet chuckle, shaking her head. She always made fun of herself for it, but I could tell she really hated being alone at night. Her fingers tighten around the fabric of her dress.

^I hope… I hope she’s not scared anymore. Wherever she is. I just… I want you to find who did this. She turns to you, her expression unreadable. For her. For you. Her voice catches slightly on the last word.
^You deserve to know the truth… and she deserves justice. And when you do find out who did this… promise me you won’t let them get away with it. There is a decisive almost look in her eyes.
